author: DotNetCloud Contributors
name: DotNetCloud module
description: A minimal DotNetCloud module host: lifecycle service, health check, manifest and a NuGet.config that resolves the module contracts from the sdk-feed of the platform you installed.

moduleId.description: Reverse-DNS module id. Lowercase; it is also the host assembly name and the directory name the supervisor discovers.

sdkVersion.description: The DotNetCloud platform version whose sdk-feed you build against.

sdkFeed.description: Path to the sdk-feed folder of your DotNetCloud install.
